description: The same two invalid modes as `invalid-break-paths-domains`, written on the **mark definition** rather than in `config.mark` — and the domains are measured over different rows because of it. `assembleDomain` asks `getMarkConfig('invalid', markDef, config)`, and `getMarkConfig` reads only the configuration chain where `getMarkPropOrConfig` would read the mark definition first, so an `invalid` written here never reaches the choice of which output a domain is measured over. The point on the left hides its gaps and measures its domains over the rows it kept; the line on the right breaks at its gaps and measures over the rows it drew. Neither needs a second dataset, where the same two modes in a configuration need one apiece.
